title: lactuca cyprica
intro: Lactuca cyprica, commonly known as wild lettuce, is a perennial plant species in the sunflower family (Asteraceae) native to the Mediterranean region. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving sleep quality, and exhibiting antioxidant properties that may help protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Lactuca cyprica include sedative, anxiolytic, and anti-spasmodic effects, making it a sought-after natural remedy for promoting relaxation and alleviating muscle tension. The bioactive constituents of Lactuca cyprica include lactucarium, a complex mixture of flavonoids, alkaloids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
